title: Concept: List of submitted identity documents
description: A list of KYC documents with their types and numbers in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The list says which documents the bank holds and in what number order, which is what an impersonator needs to answer questions about the file.
applicability: Deployments that render a list of KYC documents with their types and numbers into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The list says which documents the bank holds and in what number order, which is what an impersonator needs to answer questions about the file.
